customMethods.script:
#	system.perspective.print("buildGraphic() called")
	
	def buildElement(value, label, direction, hexColor, basis, grow, shrink):
		if value is None: return None
				
		if value != '':	value = float(value)
			
		element = {
					"instanceStyle": {
					  "classes": "",
					  "fontWeight": "bold"
					},
					"instancePosition": {
					  "grow": grow,
					  "shrink": shrink,
					  "basis": str(basis) + '%'
					},
					"specName": label,
					"barColor": hexColor,
					"direction": direction,
					"specValue": value
				  }
				  
		return element
		
	instances = []

	LSL = self.view.params.values.LSL
	USL = self.view.params.values.USL
	LCL = self.view.params.values.LCL
	UCL = self.view.params.values.UCL
	TGT = self.view.params.values.Target
	actual = self.view.params.values.ProcessValue

	if USL is not None and LSL is not None:	#Not much I can do if specs haven't been set
	
		if LCL == 0: LCL = None
		if UCL == 0: UCL = None
		
		basis = 5
		
	#	range = float(USL - LSL) - (basis * 2)
		range = float(USL - LSL)
		if range == 0.0: range = 1.0
	#	system.perspective.print("Range is " + str(range))
	
		LSLBasis = None
		LCLBasis = None
		tgtBasis = None
		UCLBasis = None
	
		if LSL is not None and USL is not None:
			LSLBasis = basis
	#		system.perspective.print("LSLBasis is " + str(LSLBasis))
	#		system.perspective.print("USLBasis is " + str(LSLBasis))		
			
			if LCL is not None and LCL != 0: LCLBasis = ((LCL - LSL) / range) * 100.0
	#		system.perspective.print("LCLBasis is " + str(LCLBasis))
	
			if LCL is not None and UCL is not None:	tgtBasis = ((UCL - LCL) / range) * 100.0
			elif LSL is not None and USL is not None: tgtBasis = ((USL - LSL) / range) * 100.0		
			
			if UCL is not None:	UCLBasis = ((USL - UCL) / range) * 100.0
	#		system.perspective.print("UCLBasis is " + str(UCLBasis))			
		
			element = buildElement(LSL, 'LSL', 'right', '--kcRed-40', LSLBasis, 0,0)
			if element is not None:	instances.append(element)
			element = buildElement(LCL, 'LCL', 'right', '--kcOrange-40', LCLBasis, 1,1)
			if element is not None: instances.append(element)
	
	#		system.perspective.print("Building tgtBasis element with " + str(tgtBasis))
			if TGT is None:
				TGT = ''
				label = ''
			else:
				label = 'TGT'	
			element = buildElement(TGT, label, 'center', '--kcGray-0', tgtBasis, 1,1)
	#		system.perspective.print('tgt element is ' + str(element))
			if element is not None:
				instances.append(element)	
						
			element = buildElement(UCL, 'UCL', 'left', '--kcOrange-40', UCLBasis, 1,1)
			if element is not None: instances.append(element)			
			element = buildElement(USL, 'USL', 'left', '--kcRed-40', LSLBasis, 0,0)
			if element is not None: instances.append(element)			


#	system.perspective.print("Setting specIndicator to " + str(instances))				
	self.getChild("FlexRepeater").props.instances = instances
	
	return
